'''Summoned skeletons''' are monsters that appear throughout [[the Shadow Reef]]. They may be spawned by [[ulthven necromancer]]s, [[corpse carrier]]s, [[Bossy McBossFace]], [[Taraket the Necromancer]], or just as normal monsters.

In story mode, their life points is 4,500, down from 9,000.
